name: company-shuttle
description: Self-hosted, open-source-first real-time company shuttle pickup platform

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @shuttle/shared-types && npm run build -w @shuttle/shared-utils && npm run build -w @shuttle/ui && npm run build -w @shuttle/client
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @shuttle/backend && npm run build -w @shuttle/employee && npm run build -w @shuttle/admin
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n pkgs,api,emp,admin -c gray,green,blue,yellow "npm:dev:packages" "npm:dev -w @shuttle/backend" "npm:dev -w @shuttle/employee" "npm:dev -w @shuttle/admin"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @shuttle/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
